roots.title: Global Optimization
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Global Optimization; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Continuous Global Problem Classes
children.top_down_role: Navigation for continuous nonconvex global optimization organized by solution semantics, information structure, canonical model families, reformulations, bounds, certificates, methods, complexity, implementation, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Convex Underestimation
children.top_down_role: Convex and related rigorous lower-bounding structures for deterministic global optimization, from envelope theory through computational certificates; full optimization algorithms and specialized polynomial hierarchies remain cross-linked.

children.title: Factorable Relaxations
children.top_down_role: Recursive convex and concave relaxation of explicitly decomposable nonlinear expressions; global-search orchestration, general interval analysis, and specialized algebraic hierarchies remain cross-linked.

children.title: AlphaBB Convexification
children.top_down_role: Curvature-based convex underestimation for smooth nonconvex functions on bounded domains, including certificates, parameter-estimation families, extensions, computational interfaces, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Relaxation Validity
children.top_down_role: Structural foundations that make relaxation-derived bounds and certificates trustworthy across domain restriction, reformulation, branching, pruning, termination, and numerical implementation.

children.title: Classical Deterministic Global Model Families
children.top_down_role: Classical structured continuous nonconvex model families and their family-specific deterministic global solution architectures; generic convex analysis, general-purpose spatial branch-and-bound, stochastic search, polynomial moment methods, and application domains are linked but not developed here.

children.title: Spatial Subdivision Global Search
children.top_down_role: Deterministic global-search architecture based on spatial subdivision, valid regional bounds, incumbent management, domain reduction, pruning, and verifiable termination; detailed construction of relaxation families is owned by linked chapters.

children.title: Validated Interval Global Optimization
children.top_down_role: Rigorous global optimization over continuous domains using interval enclosures, contractors, exhaustive subdivision, and machine-checkable numerical certificates.

children.title: Regularity-Based Partition Search
children.top_down_role: Deterministic global optimization based on Lipschitz regularity, geometric lower bounds, adaptive domain partitions, and DIRECT-type searches over compact continuous domains.

children.title: Continuous Global Solver Workflows
children.top_down_role: Deterministic and hybrid workflows that turn continuous nonconvex models, bounding mechanisms, domain reduction, and incumbent search into globally certified computations; foundational relaxation theory and problem-class-specific global optimization remain cross-linked.

children.title: Polynomial Problem Classes
children.top_down_role: Navigation for polynomial and semialgebraic optimization formulations, canonical model families, structural classifications, representation choices, and the AC optimal power flow polynomial template.

children.title: Positivity Objects
children.top_down_role: Scalar polynomial nonnegativity, SOS representations, positivity-cone geometry, exactness regimes, Gram geometry, rational-denominator representations, and recognition boundaries. Positivity certificates generated by semialgebraic constraints, moment hierarchies, alternative positivity cones, polynomial convexity, matrix positivity, and free positivity remain in neighboring chapters.

children.title: Algebraic Positivity Certificates
children.top_down_role: Navigation for algebraic representations of polynomial positivity and infeasibility, ordered from certificate algebras through landmark representation families, geometric specializations, quantitative bounds, computational realization, and failure boundaries. Moment duality and full polynomial-optimization hierarchies remain cross-linked dependencies.

children.title: Certificate Assumptions
children.top_down_role: Structural conditions governing when algebraic positivity certificates and moment-SOS constructions apply, become exact, or fail; certificate constructions and hierarchy mechanics remain in neighboring chapters.

children.title: Moment Relaxations
children.top_down_role: Moment-based convex relaxations for polynomial and generalized moment optimization, including their representations, hierarchy families, exactness mechanisms, computational variants, and failure boundaries.

children.title: SOS Hierarchies
children.top_down_role: Semidefinite and moment-SOS hierarchy architectures for polynomial optimization, including their representations, duality, convergence, extraction, scalable variants, computational interfaces, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Structure-Exploiting Polynomial Optimization
children.top_down_role: Scalable representations, relaxations, certificate pipelines, computational regimes, and reliability boundaries for polynomial optimization.

children.title: Convex MINLP Decomposition Architecture
children.top_down_role: Convex mixed-integer nonlinear model structure, relaxation geometry, decomposition theory, integrated exact methods, solver architectures, certificates, and convexity-dependent failure boundaries.

children.title: Nonconvex MINLP Global Search
children.top_down_role: Deterministic global optimization of mixed-integer nonlinear models through structure recognition, convex relaxation, domain reduction, spatial search, certification, and computational assessment.

children.title: Nonconvex MICP Global Optimization
children.top_down_role: Global optimization of mixed-integer models whose nonconvex structure is bounded, relaxed, or certified through conic representations; convex MICP theory appears only where it supplies certificates or computational oracles.
